verdict.summary: The cache is opt-in, paired with an exact index-byte receipt, and defaults to the original FullFrameDataset path. Known cache-QA manifests are rejected by training, teacher and accuracy evaluation while only explicit CPU QA tools opt in. Road and COCO CPU first-batch reports bind current manifests/caches; an independent road rerun reproduced exact inputs, heads, losses, 195 gradients and all model/BN state for Mosaic off/on.

default_and_protocol_review.default_dataset_factory: make_frame_dataset with no cache arguments returns an exact FullFrameDataset instance.
default_and_protocol_review.paired_options: cache_root and cache_index_sha256 must either both be absent or both be supplied; a 64-hex receipt is required.
default_and_protocol_review.lazy_import: disk_cache is imported only on the opt-in branch, so the default data path and class remain unchanged.
default_and_protocol_review.ordering_reasoning: Cache construction/validation consumes no training RNG. A resumed run restores checkpoint RNG after datasets and optimizer are created, and per-epoch shuffle remains explicitly seeded by seed+epoch. Mosaic selection remains index/epoch/seed deterministic.
default_and_protocol_review.validate_only: Pinned COCO cache validation exited successfully without creating cnn/runs/cache_validate_only_not_created.

default_rejecting_entrypoints: cnn.evaluate raw subset/development-domain mode through explicit reject_cache_qa
explicit_cpu_qa_allowlist: cnn.profile_preprocess legacy in-memory CPU preprocessing QA

dynamic_checks.error: cache QA manifest is forbidden for training or accuracy evaluation

qa_manifest_entrypoint_review.conclusion: The earlier training_eligible=true pilot ambiguity is now fail-closed at actual training and accuracy-evaluation entrypoints. Only named, bounded CPU QA tools can opt in.

receipt_and_integrity_review.check_timing: DiskCachedDataset reads index.json once, hashes those exact bytes against the required receipt before JSON parsing and before source/blob reads, then parses the already-verified bytes.
receipt_and_integrity_review.manifest_and_content_binding: After receipt verification, the reader checks cache contract/status, exact manifest SHA, dataset-content identity, preprocessing contract/source/library identity, every row/source/offset, blob size and whole-blob hash.
receipt_and_integrity_review.runtime_record_check: Every record read verifies exact length and its per-record SHA-256.
receipt_and_integrity_review.train_and_val: The same required receipt is used independently when constructing both train and val datasets.
receipt_and_integrity_review.direct_script_compatibility: python cnn/train.py imports the opt-in cache through the fallback module path; --help and the recorded direct-script validate-only check succeed.
receipt_and_integrity_review.qa_cache_separation: QA caches cannot be paired with a non-QA/full manifest because manifest/content/row counts and hashes fail; their QA manifest is independently rejected by the real trainer.

independent_cpu_checks.result: exit 0; direct-script imports and cache CLI arguments available

cpu_conclusion_boundary.proved: For two deterministic CPU FP32 microbatches of size 2, one Mosaic-off and one Mosaic-on, raw and pinned-cache paths produce identical inputs, sample keys, heads, loss components, 195 gradient tensors and complete post-forward model/BN state.
cpu_conclusion_boundary.saved_checkpoint: No optimizer step or checkpoint write occurred; last.pt remains epoch 6 display / zero-based 5 with SHA-256 51da8c... and the training log timestamp is unchanged.

findings.evidence: The cache path/receipt are emitted in startup and start-log metadata but intentionally excluded from protocol_for and checkpoint fields so raw/cache runs remain resume-compatible.
findings.disposition: Preserve the start log and require an explicitly reviewed receipt on every cached invocation. Resume eligibility proves the training protocol is unchanged; it does not prove that a later operator supplied the same cache receipt. This is not blocking because the cache is opt-in and content/preprocessing-bound.

findings.evidence: Only first batches with batch=2, workers=0, CPU FP32, Mosaic off/on were compared; no optimizer update occurred.
findings.disposition: Do not claim GPU, AMP, accumulation, full-epoch, speed or accuracy equivalence. Before actual GPU continuation, keep the cache switch reversible and perform the planned input/order/loss smoke comparison in the target execution configuration.

findings.evidence: The current exclusive cache builder remains capped at 128 images, so these reports validate integration contracts and small pilots only.
findings.disposition: A separately reviewed full-data builder/receipt is still required before cached full-dataset training; no automatic GPU resume is warranted by this milestone.

final_process_state: No Python process using the dedicated road_yolo_venv executable was present at the final reviewer check.
